data.title: [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting Details
data.brief: Dear Endministrator,6★ operators that may appear in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting include
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

6★ operators that may appear in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting include: Laevatain / Gilberta / Ardelia / Pogranichnik.

The [Shimmering Moment] limited-time sign-in event will open simultaneously. Accumulate sign-ins to earn rewards such as [Shimmering Moment HH Permit]×5. You can also exchange for [Shimmering Moment HH Permit] at a discount in [AIC Quota Exchange].


▼// [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting Details

· Availability: May 14, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


· Participation Criteria: Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]

· 6★ operators that may appear in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting include: Laevatain / Gilberta / Ardelia / Pogranichnik.

· In [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, you can use [Shimmering Moment HH Permit], [Chartered HH Permit] or [Oroberyls] to perform headhunting.

※ [Fest of Brilliance] is a special headhunting banner exclusive to the [At the Wake of Spring] version, opened for this special arrangement and governed by rules applicable only to this banner. [Fest of Brilliance] is separate from existing headhunting types and rules, and does not carry over to or from other headhunting banners.


▼// [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting Rewards

In [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, perform a certain number of headhunting attempts to earn corresponding rewards.


■ [Fest of Brilliance] Tribute: Bond Quota

· In [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, each headhunting or Urgent Recruitment attempt gives a bonus [Bond Quota]×1.

■ Urgent Recruitment

· After performing 30 headhunting attempts in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, you will receive 10 bonus Urgent Recruitment attempts (which count as 1 free 10× headhunting attempt). This is only valid during this [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting banner, and does not carry over to other headhunting banners.

· The rates for obtaining operators through Urgent Recruitment are the same as the base drop rates of [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, and the free 10× headhunting attempt from Urgent Recruitment guarantees a 5★ or better operator.

· The free 10× headhunting attempt given by Urgent Recruitment does not count toward the guarantee for [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting or other headhunting banners. It also will not be added to the total headhunting attempts required for [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting rewards.

■ [Fest of Brilliance] Tribute: Basic HH Permit

· Perform a total of 60 headhunting attempts in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting to additionally receive [Basic HH Permit]×10. This bonus can only trigger 1 time in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting.

■ [Fest of Brilliance] Tribute: Shimmering Moment Designation Permit

· Perform a total of 120 headhunting attempts in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting to receive a bonus [Shimmering Moment Designation Permit]×1. This lets you choose and get one 6★ operator for free from the following: Laevatain / Gilberta / Ardelia / Pogranichnik. This bonus can only trigger 1 time in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting.

■ [Fest of Brilliance] Tribute: Shimmering Moment Token Supply

· For every 240 headhunting attempts performed in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, you will receive a bonus [Shimmering Moment Token Supply]×1. This lets you choose and get one token for free from the following: Laevatain's Token / Gilberta's Token / Ardelia's Token / Pogranichnik's Token.

※ You cannot choose a token for any listed 6★ operator you do not own.


※ The items listed above in the [Fest of Brilliance] Tribute are bonus rewards available in this Special Headhunting banner. They will not affect operator drop rates or the guarantee count for [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting or other headhunting banners.

※ Upon the conclusion of [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, the accumulated attempts will reset to zero and will not carry over to any future headhunting banners.


▼// Arsenal Ticket Details

Every headhunting attempt for operators also gives [Arsenal Tickets].

· Acquiring a 6★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×2000.

· Acquiring a 5★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×200.

· Acquiring a 4★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×20.

※ [Arsenal Tickets] can be spent at the [Acquisition Center - Arsenal Exchange].


During [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting, the following content will also be available:

▼// [Shimmering Moment] Limited-Time Sign-In Event

Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [Shimmering Moment HH Permit]×5.


▼// [AIC Quota Exchange] Special Note

The [Quota Exchange] will offer limited-time special deals. You can spend AIC Quota to purchase items such as [Shimmering Moment HH Permit]×5.


※ For more headhunting details, check the in-game [Headhunting] screen.

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

※ For details on [AIC Quota Exchange], check the in-game [Acquisition Center].
